_comment: Class schedule source. `url_templates` is empty until TXST's schedule site has been checked in a browser: fill in one or more GET URLs using {term_code}, {subject}, {year} and {season}. If the site only works through a form POST or an API, it needs a small adapter in app/structured/build.py instead. Until then, load exports with `python -m app.structured.build --import-csv FILE --term "Fall 2026"`. Instructor columns are never stored. `term_codes` follow a common Banner pattern and are a guess until checked.
